text: Implemented first-class participants.tsv support: BidsProject now carries participantsTable: Option[BidsTable], the JVM loader caches participants.tsv while preserving strict/lax behavior, readParticipantsTable(project) exposes cached-or-disk access, and readTable(project, BidsPath(...)) supports arbitrary BIDS TSV reads. Added shared and JVM regression tests for dataframe-like participant columns, strict/lax missing participants.tsv behavior, and missing participant_id rejection. Verification: sbt bidsJVM/test bidsJS/test passed with 41 JVM and 35 Scala.js tests. Aggregate sbt compileAll testAll is currently blocked before BIDS by unrelated linalgJVM compile errors in modules/linalg/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/linalg/LinearMap.scala where Either[LinearMapError,CsrMatrix] is inferred where Int arrays are expected.
